core_meaning.primary_meaning: Fiddah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Silver”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fiddah corresponds to the Arabic form فِضَّة (Arabic root ف ض ض (f-ḍ-ḍ)). Its core sense is silver. Fiddah is the Arabic word فِضَّة (fiḍḍa) 'silver' — also a female given name, associated with purity and brightness. The source gloss 'The Scattered' is not the lexical meaning and has not been carried over. Fizza (fizza) is a common South Asian spelling of the same name.

persian.name: نقره
